info.title: iris - AI coding assistant with read, bash, edit, write tools
info.description: Iris, a terminal coding agent with read, bash, edit and write tools, fullscreen TUI and C# extensions.

commands.name: auth
commands.description: Print credentials or check provider readiness

commands.name: config
commands.description: Open TUI to enable/disable resources (Tab switches scope)

options.name: --local
options.description: Edit project overrides (.iris/settings.json)

options.name: --approve
options.description:
Trust project-local files for this command with -l
-na, --no-approve Ignore project-local files for this command with -l

options.name: --help
options.description: Show this help

options.name: --check
options.description: Only report whether a newer version is available

options.name: --help
options.description: Show this help

options.name: --provider
options.description: Provider name (default: google)

options.name: --model
options.description: Model pattern or ID (supports "provider/id" and optional ":<thinking>")

options.name: --api-key
options.description: API key (defaults to env vars)

options.name: --system-prompt
options.description: System prompt (default: coding assistant prompt)

options.name: --append-system-prompt
options.description: Append text or file contents to the system prompt (can be used multiple times)

options.name: --mode
options.description: Output mode: text (default), json, or rpc

options.name: --print
options.description: Non-interactive mode: process prompt and exit

options.name: --continue
options.description: Continue previous session

options.name: --resume
options.description: Select a session to resume

options.name: --session
options.description: Use specific session file or partial UUID

options.name: --session-id
options.description: Use exact project session ID, creating it if missing

options.name: --fork
options.description: Fork specific session file or partial UUID into a new session

options.name: --session-dir
options.description: Directory for session storage and lookup

options.name: --no-session
options.description: Don't save session (ephemeral)

options.name: --name
options.description: Set session display name

options.name: --models
options.description:
Comma-separated model patterns for Ctrl+P cycling
Supports globs (anthropic/*, *sonnet*) and fuzzy matching

options.name: --no-tools
options.description: Disable all tools by default (built-in and extension)

options.name: --no-builtin-tools
options.description: Disable built-in tools by default but keep extension/custom tools enabled

options.name: --tools
options.description:
Comma-separated allowlist of tool names to enable
Applies to built-in, extension, and custom tools

options.name: --exclude-tools
options.description: Comma-separated denylist of tool names to disable

options.name: --thinking
options.description: Set thinking level: off, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max

options.name: --extension
options.description: Load an extension file (can be used multiple times)

options.name: --no-extensions
options.description: Disable extension discovery (explicit -e paths still work)

options.name: --skill
options.description: Load a skill file or directory (can be used multiple times)

options.name: --no-skills
options.description: Disable skills discovery and loading

options.name: --prompt-template
options.description: Load a prompt template file or directory (can be used multiple times)

options.name: --no-prompt-templates
options.description: Disable prompt template discovery and loading

options.name: --theme
options.description: Load a theme file or directory (can be used multiple times)

options.name: --use-theme
options.description: Set the initial interactive theme for this run

options.name: --no-themes
options.description: Disable theme discovery and loading

options.name: --no-context-files
options.description: Disable AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md discovery and loading

options.name: --export
options.description: Export session file to HTML and exit

options.name: --list-models
options.description: List available models (with optional fuzzy search)

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Force verbose startup (overrides quietStartup setting)

options.name: --tui-mode
options.description: TUI mode: fullscreen (default) or regular

options.name: --approve
options.description: Trust project-local files for this run

options.name: --no-approve
options.description: Ignore project-local files for this run

options.name: --offline
options.description:
Disable startup network operations (same as IRIS_OFFLINE=1)
